children: Newton Golf advanced its multi-tranche private placement, securing $271,000 in gross proceeds as a September Investor purchased 215,079 common shares at $1.26 per share on September 15, 2026. The second tranche follows a $1.0 million first tranche closed on August 14, 2026, under a Securities Purchase Agreement targeting up to $5.0 million in total proceeds. Concurrently, the September Investor joined the company’s Registration Rights Agreement to facilitate the resale of the purchased shares, supporting investor liquidity while the company strengthens its capital position.
